# Pre

::: {.callout-note}
The `uv` python interpreter lives in `~/minstallation/.venvs/KKIK_parse/bin/python`

Render one report per compartment from the project root (requires `papermill` for `-P`):

```bash
for c in Stromal; do
    quarto render 6_annotation/6_annotation.qmd -P compartment:$c &&
        mv 6_annotation/6_annotation.html 6_annotation/6_annotation_$c.html
done
```
:::

Parameters:

```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
compartment = "Stromal"
```

```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import plotnine as gg
import yaml
import session_info
```

Figure settings:

```{python}
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = "Nimbus sans"
```

Random settings / parameters:

```{python}
step = "6_annotation"
random_state = 275
with open("config/annotation.yaml") as fh:
    annotation = yaml.safe_load(fh)[compartment.lower()]
res = annotation["resolution"]
```

Create folders for outputs:

```{python}
resdir = f"{step}/outputs/{compartment}/files"
os.makedirs(resdir, exist_ok=True)
```

Read the `{python} compartment` object from the subclustering step:

```{python}
adata = sc.read_h5ad(f"5_subclustering/outputs/{compartment}/files/sc.h5ad")
```

# Assign cell types

Clusters at resolution `{python} res` are mapped to `cell_type_3` (refined) with the dictionary in `config/annotation.yaml`. `cell_type_2` groups `cell_type_3` into general cell types (e.g. all blood endothelium as `Endothelial_cells`); if no grouping is defined, both levels are the same.

```{python}
adata.obs["cell_type_3"] = adata.obs[f"leiden_{res}"].astype(str).map(annotation["clusters"])
adata.obs["cell_type_2"] = adata.obs["cell_type_3"].map(
    lambda ct: annotation.get("cell_type_2", {}).get(ct, ct)
)
```

Unassigned clusters (should be empty): `{python} adata.obs.loc[adata.obs["cell_type_3"].isna(), f"leiden_{res}"].unique().tolist()`

Cluster to cell type equivalence:

```{python}
(
    adata.obs.groupby([f"leiden_{res}", "cell_type_3", "cell_type_2"], observed=True)
    .size()
    .rename("n")
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values(f"leiden_{res}", key=lambda c: c.astype(int))
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.embedding(adata, basis="umap_harmony", color=f"leiden_{res}", legend_loc="on data")
sc.pl.embedding(adata, basis="umap_harmony", color=["cell_type_2", "cell_type_3"])
```

# Remove contamination and doublets

Cell types removed: `{python} annotation.get("exclude", [])`

```{python}
excluded = adata.obs["cell_type_3"].isin(annotation.get("exclude", []))
adata.obs.loc[excluded, "cell_type_3"].value_counts()
```

```{python}
adata = adata[~excluded].copy()
for col in ["cell_type_2", "cell_type_3"]:
    adata.obs[col] = adata.obs[col].astype("category")
```

Cells after removal: `{python} adata.n_obs`

```{python}
sc.pl.embedding(adata, basis="umap_harmony", color=["cell_type_2", "cell_type_3"])
```

# Markers per cell type

```{python}
#| output: asis
print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")
for level in ["cell_type_2", "cell_type_3"]:
    print(f"\n## {level}\n")
    sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(
        adata,
        groupby=level,
        method="wilcoxon",
        use_raw=False,
        key_added=f"markers_{level}",
    )
    sc.pl.rank_genes_groups_dotplot(adata, key=f"markers_{level}", n_genes=5)
print("\n:::\n")
```

# Composition

```{python}
#| output: asis
print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")
for level in ["cell_type_2", "cell_type_3"]:
    print(f"\n## {level}\n")
    (
        gg.ggplot(adata.obs, gg.aes(x="sample", fill=level))
        + gg.geom_bar(position="fill")
        + gg.facet_grid(". ~ condition", scales="free_x", space="free_x")
        + gg.theme_bw()
        + gg.theme(axis_text_x=gg.element_text(rotation=90))
        + gg.labs(y="proportion")
    ).show()
print("\n:::\n")
```

# Save

```{python}
sc.write(adata=adata, filename=f"{resdir}/sc.h5ad", ext="h5ad")
```
